column8: Mon 16 Nov: store, process; confirms Q66-002's arithmetic only (28 of 35, 140 of 172 re-run); says nothing about its inputs, which rows 4-13 check.

Mon 16 Nov: aha 9 and 3e wording; corrects the label in aha 9 and Q66's verdict 1 (81% of all others): 140 of 172 is years shares rose, and Q66-002's own row labels it right; against every other year 156 of 194.
Mon 16 Nov: 3e caution, store; the 35 are five episodes, not 35 independent cases, so no tendency claim either way; sharpens Q66-001 and Q66-002's critique columns.
Mon 16 Nov: store, process; confirms Q66-001's 2001-2025 world returns at MSCI's own gross levels; gross, not net, is a known gap.
Mon 16 Nov: store, process; narrows Q66-001's unverified span: 1998-2000 now read at MSCI on price (re-derived +22.8%, +23.6%, -14.1%); 2000 is a fall above 10% on either basis.
Mon 16 Nov: 3e method; corrects Q66-001's span: the unverifiable world years are 1970-96 (1973, 1974, 1990: 10 of 36 fall country-years), which is why 3e uses the 1998-2025 count (row 13).

Mon 16 Nov: same Cambridge Associates table and 1973-74 -40.0% as Q6c-003; carry the Dec 1989-Sep 1990 -24.0% and the use (a second source for Q66-001's early falls) there; peak-to-trough cannot confirm a calendar-year fall above 10%; read via a fetch summary.
Mon 16 Nov: store, process; which years count as falls turns on the variant (2018 -10.4% price re-derived, -8.2% gross); say gross, as Q66-001 does; VT holders get about net.
Mon 16 Nov: store; confirms the inputs behind Q66-013 to Q66-020 and Q66's Taiwan series; harmonise 238 values (card) with 222 checked values (Q85_fall_country_years.csv source column).

Mon 16 Nov: 3e store; new UK PUBSEC 1980-89 (re-derived 106 to 99, -6.6%) adds UK 1990 to Q66-002's count, which had no 1989; public tenders only; a different -6.6% from the retired January 2000 example, so never in one paragraph.
Mon 16 Nov: aha 9 long-span count; corrects Q66-002 (28 of 35 against 140 of 172 becomes 28 of 36 against 149 of 181, p 0.49 re-derived); early world years still from a secondary table, so say so.
Mon 16 Nov: 3e store; corrects Q66's verdict 1 (seven that fell, all 2000-02 in Asia) to eight incl. UK 1990, re-derived from the fall-years file; demand slumps, HK's own deflation (Q66-014).

Mon 16 Nov: 3e and aha 9, the count on world years read at MSCI (18 of 25 against 76 of 99, re-derived); supersedes Q66-002 for the report; Japan's 5 of 25 were not re-read, so say the world side is what a judge can check.
Mon 16 Nov: 3e store, one clause at most; the no-tendency finding survives every variant (Fisher p 0.35-1.00 re-derived); dense list, small samples, low power.
Mon 16 Nov: 3e framing; why the report leans on size and trend, not the rise count; partly restates Q66-002's use column; Keel's reading.

Mon 16 Nov: 3e risk to record beside Q66-021 (2022); qualifies Q66-002's means: the dearer fall years are 1973-74 inflation; p 0.035 is one of about fifteen variants run, so never cite it as significant.

Mon 16 Nov: 3e and aha 9 (above trend half the time); reproduces Q66-003 (15 of 30 against 86 of 178) on re-read building series and supersedes it for use; 178 is every year shares fell 10% or less; early world years secondary.
Mon 16 Nov: store, process; Q66's yearly averages sit half a year off calendar returns (the Q66-008 mismatch); the count holds (29 of 36), the example does not.
Mon 16 Nov: store; Japan's three-index splice is a weak link in Q66-002 and Q66-022; dropping Japan changes nothing (row 14); MLIT not re-read.

Mon 16 Nov: aha 9 guard; corrects Q66-005 (fell or stalled in 7 of 9) to fell in 6 of 9, two more flat or nearly so (UK 0.0% on a whole-number index, Japan FY1975 +0.8%), re-derived; register already carries it.

Mon 16 Nov: 3e or Table 3 row 7 footnote (name the index); closes Q66-018's open critique: NOCOS labels read, Combined 78 to 90 (+15.4%) against PUBSEC -20.4%, re-derived; Q66-018's 14-20% across columns stands, cite Combined.
Mon 16 Nov: 3e store; confirms Q66-011's -6.6% (re-derived -6.59% from MSCI levels) but shows it rests on end-of-January dates and no 2000 dividends; row 23 replaces it for use.

Mon 16 Nov: aha 9 and 3e example; corrects Q66-011: on Laura's start-of-January dates world shares (MSCI ACWI, never VT) were about 10% down (re-derived -9.83%; price only -16.72%); register and SKELETON adopted.
Mon 16 Nov: aha 9 cost side; confirms Q66-011's +17.9% (55.05 to 64.91) and gives +18.4% Jan 2003-Dec 2004, both re-derived; January 2003 rests on the repo copy of DGBAS.

Mon 16 Nov: 3e method; fix contribution Dec 2032: it is the 2033 contribution, paid from funds maturing late 2032 (8q counts the need in December 2032 money); VT bought Jan 2028, meetings 36 months on (move 1 Jan 2031, 8r).

Mon 16 Nov: aha 9 and 3e; corrects Q66-011's currency mismatch (US-dollar shares against NT$ costs): +28.0% and +27.2% in US dollars re-derived from the FRED mirror; the dollar need is the one her flexibility meets (8q).

Mon 16 Nov: 3e or Table 3 row 7 note; re-run: 48 of 405 NT$ windows at or above +17.9% (about 1 in 8), and the Jan 2003-Jan 2005 window is itself 8q's 1-in-20 point (+28.0%), so the example and the stress are one event; overlapping windows.

Mon 16 Nov: aha 9 wording; corrects Q66-037 and the old smallest-when-needed line: shares were lowest at the 2003 meetings (re-derived -40.6%/-42.1%) and up 56-57% by 2005; a low price then also lowers the stated top (8p).
Mon 16 Nov: 3e guard; corrects Q66-010: its 3 of 5 against 4 of 20 becomes 1 of 5 against 5 of 19 on start-of-January buys; only the 2000 window holds on both, so never the 3 of 5.
Mon 16 Nov: 3e support; NUMBERS 8q's January purchases fail only in 1988 and 2000 (29 of 31, read in 8q), so the example agrees with the register; US shares stand in there.

Mon 16 Nov: one window of Q66-009's U-shape (Q66-010's critique already names 2003 +24.0% with shares +123.8%); carry the two-convention ranges (124-137%, 21.5-24.0%, cost side re-derived) there; can, never tends to.
Mon 16 Nov: store; Turner's own definition supports Q66's pooling it with tender indices (Q66-002 method); quote read via a search extract.
Mon 16 Nov: store; confirms Q66-005's US -8.4% (2009) and Q66-021's Turner +8.0% (2022) at Turner's releases, re-derived; national, non-residential, read via search extracts.
Mon 16 Nov: gap for the next round; Singapore before 2005 is behind a paywall; serves no part until read.

Mon 16 Nov: 3e and aha 9 count, supersedes Q66-002 and Q66-037's count; fix the mixed spans: the trend result (15 of 30) and only-1973-74 come from the long span, so name it or re-run on 1998-2025; Japan not re-read, so checkable at MSCI is the world side.
Mon 16 Nov: aha 9 and 3e example in note form; supersedes Q66-011 and Q66-037's example; matches the register and SKELETON 3e as corrected; never VT; the report says her flexibility, not half kept.
